anti_trude_medium: Reversible Astrological Loom & Homeomorphic Stain Diptych (Canvas 2D Knot-Weave Magnifier + Crumbling Alley Topography + Pythagorean Oud/Astral WebAudio)

calvino_stones.text: Spreads both upward and down, with winding alleys, steps, dead ends, hovels
Packed mules jostling in narrow passages amid bustle, throngs, and shoving
Black stains of smoke and smell of fish rising from crooked lanes
Preserved symmetrical carpet repeating motifs along straight and circular lines
Interwoven spires and arabesques of crimson, indigo, and magenta threads with finger-traceable enclosures
Every place in the carpet corresponds to a place in the city; straight crimson or indigo threads map crooked quarter routes
A stain spreading shapelessly with crumbling stone walls, landslides, houses crumbling one upon another amid clouds of dust
Fires and screams in the darkness
Oracle's augury: one object has the form the gods gave the starry sky and world orbits—either the harmonious carpet OR the shapeless crumbling stain itself

eudoxia-carpet-weaver.mission: Interactive crimson/indigo/magenta knotted geometric carpet with straight & circular enclosures, zoom thread-loupe revealing homeomorphic micro-links to crooked alleys, straight/circular route tracing, and crystalline oud/harp harmonic WebAudio.

eudoxia-shapeless-stain.mission: Chaotic mule-packed hovels, winding steps, dead ends, black smoke stains, fish-smell brine, crumbling landslides, dust clouds, fires, and screams in darkness + Oracle's Reversible Cosmology switch proving BOTH carpet and shapeless stain map the starry sky and revolving world orbits.

eudoxia-weaver.mission: 100% standalone index.html splicing both layers inline via Python, bespoke custom DOM tags (J_dom < 0.35, 0 generic wrappers, 100% .eud-* classes), 1280x800 & 390x844 responsive layout, keyboard & reduced-motion support, and <eudoxia-plate-drawer> [P] displaying map.png (1600x1200) & image.png (1600x1000).

eudoxia-critic.mission: Blindfolded read-only auditor verifying HG-1..HG-4 + map.png/map.svg/image.png integrity via Python & headless Chromium.

hard_gates.HG-1: Standalone purity & blind recognition: 0 occurrences of http://, https://, or ../ in index.html & layers/*.js (no xmlns http URLs in inline SVG); 0 console/page errors; title-masked recognition of Eudoxia.
hard_gates.HG-2: Calvino stones & Inner Arch invariants: all 9 canonical loci bridged 1-to-1; crimson/indigo/magenta symmetrical carpet zoom loupe reveals micro-weave homeomorphic links; quarter-to-quarter straight/circular thread maps to tortuous crooked alley path; packed mules, black smoke, fish smell, landslides/dust, fires & screams active; Oracle reversible cosmology switch proves BOTH carpet_cosmos AND stain_cosmos validly map the starry sky & world orbits.
hard_gates.HG-3: Viewports, accessibility & plate drawer: 1280x800 desktop & 390x844 mobile zero horizontal overflow & zero control occlusion; keyboard navigation (1-9, O, L, T, D, P, Z, M, R, Escape); prefers-reduced-motion honored; <eudoxia-plate-drawer> [P] loads map.png & image.png cleanly with [hidden]{display:none!important}.
